strengths: Transparent and disciplined two-layer scope calibration (Sec. 1) explicitly distinguishing universal Lean 4 algebraic/inductive proofs, finite exact-Q witness verification, and unformalized analytic pillars in [3].

Zero-dependency constructive Lean 4.35.0 formalization (Table 1) with zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, and 4 zero-axiom theorems, with every stated integer identity and inequality mathematically sound.

Sharp, completely exact-rational isospectral separation witness (Sec. 4.1, Fig. 1(a), Table 2) contrasting Boolean S = J4 - 2I4 (rank 4, bias 1/2, spectrum (1/2,1/2,1/2,1/2), E3 = 3/2, hollow slice energy 3/32) against 8x8 Rademacher A_Rad (identical rank, bias, unit L^2(mu) norms, and spectrum, yet E3 = 0 and hollow energy 0), plus exact closed form E3 = 4(n-1)(n-2)/n^2 on Jn - 2In.

Rigorous zero-floating-point Python Fraction auditor design (Sec. 3) rejecting IEEE-754 floats, NaN/Infinity, and duplicate JSON keys, backed by 62/62 exact-branch adversarial forgery rejections (Sec. 4.3).
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact-Q isospectral Boolean vs. Rademacher barrier witness pair (S = J4 - 2I4 vs. 8x8 A_Rad(x,y) = 1/2 + 1/2 <x,y>) isolating third-moment energy E3 = 3/2 vs. 0 and hollow slice energy 3/32 vs. 0 at identical rank, bias, and singular spectrum.
summary: This manuscript presents an explicitly scoped, two-layer zero-floating-point verification stack for the algebraic, spectral-tensor, Bregman-divergence, and Nisan-Wigderson recursion components of Google Research Cogentic's O(r^(1/2 - 5e-6)) Log-Rank Conjecture proof [3]. Layer 1 provides 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (zero sorry, zero Classical.choice; 4 zero-axiom and 14 [propext, Quot.sound]) covering Eq. (1.6) Booleanity, elementary AM-GM and cosh-tilt cancellation inequalities, Eq. (1.7) penalty concavity/slope, scalar Eq. (2.2) Bregman nonnegativity, the 2x2 commutator trace identity, list-inductive leverage defect, 2D Hermite covariance, and discrete Proposition A.3 arithmetic/induction steps. Layer 2 (LOGRANK-COGENTIC-CERT-1.0) implements a pure-Fraction auditor across four modes, certifying 16 canonical witnesses—highlighted by an exact-Q isospectral separation between S = J4 - 2I4 and the 8x8 Rademacher matrix A_Rad—and rejecting 62/62 adversarial forgeries. Every identity, rational witness calculation, rank-split, and orbit length visible in the PDF checks out independently, and heavy analytic pillars in [3] are honestly excluded. Despite elementary Lean scope and minor notation slips, there are no unresolved material objections.
weaknesses: The 18 Lean 4 theorems are mathematically elementary (polynomial identities and integer inequalities over Z, list induction, and 2x2 Z-matrices) and do not formalize the general qxq matrix Bregman divergence (Eq. 2.2), general qxq commutator trace identity, or an end-to-end Lean theorem composing Proposition A.3's lemmas into a global depth bound.

As explicitly acknowledged, the deep analytic pillars of [3] (existence of equilibrium measure mu, Efron-Stein thinning, self-normalized matrix Khintchine / tensor-power lifting, and Gaussian hypercontractivity) are not verified by either layer.

Witness matrices/vectors for Mode 2 (e.g. test matrices w in Q^{|X|xq}) and alignment with exact numbering in the external preprint [3] cannot be independently checked from the PDF alone without consulting external repository files.
